value.message: Oakville has Preschool A Learn to Swim Saturdays 9:00-9:30, Sept 12 to Nov 28, and Preschool B Saturdays 9:40-10:10, same dates, both for ages 3-5 without a parent - their site says. Fall registration opens Aug 11 at 7am for residents. I could not pin down the price. I'll keep watching and text you when I can get to it.
